mentions.name: Harness Training
mentions.description: A PyTorch-like training framework for agent harnesses. The harness is trained once with a frozen task LLM against a given task environment; the frozen trained harness can then be evaluated with any swapped-in task LLM on any new task environment. It interfaces with any OpenAI-compatible API for the task LLM and can train against Terminal-Bench or SWE-Bench tasks, and is extensible to other task environments. Results show improved general capabilities across many task LLMs and transfer of learnings to unseen task environments.
mentions.problem: A general problem of making trained agent harnesses generalize: the harness is trained once with a frozen task LLM against a given task environment, then reused and evaluated with any task LLM on any new task environment.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I worked on this project (https://github.com/workofart/harness-training) for the past few months to reframe "Agent-driven Self-improving Harness" to "Harness Training".

The idea is simple, the harness is trained once with a frozen task LLM against a given task environment. Then you can then swap out the task LLM to any model and evaluate the "frozen trained harness" with any task LLM on any new task environment.
